input.summary:
Schlafkammer furnished in parts/room-5.mjs: red bed head to the back wall under the back window (bedFrame, chest at the foot), brown carpet rug, bookshelf and chiseled bookshelf on the east wall with barrels and a poppy pot, bedside barrel with a standing lantern, two hanging lanterns from the attic floor.
make.sh wrote a whole build.nbt (24 cells placed, no REFUSED, no OFF-PALETTE from this part); mcd room says OK: 49/49 floor cells reachable, min light 8, 0 dark. Stair rail (9,7,15..17), ladder column and its approach (9,7,19), doorway lane and bed approach (11,7,20) are kept clear.
The room render reads as a bedroom from inside: the bed is the focal piece at the back, with the brightest light (E) at its head.
left: The red bed is small against the back wall and partly hidden behind the chest in the inside view; a second bed-side light or a candle on the chest would lift it, if the reviewer wants more focus.
The stair rail (9,7,15..17) and the ladder column (9,7..10,20) with backing are P1's cells; the current build has not shown them, so their presence was not verified from this part.
elements.md's interior item covers all six rooms and was not ticked; only the Schlafkammer is built.

waste.what: Worked out the 7x7 floor grid cell by cell (which x and z each bed, chest, barrel, bookshelf, rug and lantern goes in) and wrote each y layer by hand.
waste.cost: about 40 cell positions counted by hand, 2 layers() calls, 2 retries of the character offsets
waste.tool: mcd plan could emit a ready layers() legend-and-rows template with the furniture named by an inline spec, so a room designer writes a list of objects instead of counting columns.

waste.what: Checked the light by reading the grid output after the first build instead of planning lantern spots beforehand.
waste.cost: one make.sh run plus one mcd room run; the lantern spots were picked by guess, then confirmed
waste.tool: mcd room already suggests lantern spots; a --place option that writes the suggested lanterns into the layers would have saved the guess.
